name: Field Work Pack
description: Complete job checklists with measurements and photos, then download a handoff report.
features: Custom confirmation, measurement and photo fields
Versioned checklist snapshots for each work order
Validated Plan → In progress → Ready for review → Complete workflow
Inclusive numeric limits and a live unresolved-items list
Actual local photo pixels with source-file fingerprints
Browser-local project storage and full JSON import/export
Self-contained filled HTML and print reports, with explicit draft labeling
Optional private metadata workspaces with real account access
Owner/editor/viewer roles, single-use invitations and revision-conflict handling
Metadata version history and local photo reattachment
businessHypothesis: The complete local work-order and reporting workflow remains available without an account or API key. Optional paid value can come from larger private metadata workspaces, more collaborators and longer server-retained version history, using the real shared account allowance. The private application is not an advertising placement. Demand, paying customers and revenue have not been verified.
